purpose: Teach: 櫻井/杉本/鳩山/齋藤/佐伯/中谷/中井/川島

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、櫻井氏と共同事業を立ち上げられた
lines.en: When you were young, Dad, you started that joint venture with Sakurai, didn't you.
lines.style: Gentle, searching tone. Careful pacing as if retrieving a memory. Warm but slightly questioning — not quite confident in the detail. Respectful distance in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは杉本先輩のご薫陶を受けられた
lines.en: Yes. And my father learned so much from his mentor, Sugimoto.
lines.style: Steady, measured response. Light emphasis on the acknowledgment. Reflective pause before the name — honoring the memory. Quiet gratitude underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、鳩山政権の経済政策に詳しかった
lines.en: You were well-versed in economic policy during the Hatoyama administration then, weren't you.
lines.style: Soft, almost wistful cadence. Slight lift at the end — genuine curiosity about a detail from his younger days. Not challenging, but gently pressing for confirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは齋藤氏を広報の柱に据えられた
lines.en: Yes. And he made Saito the cornerstone of our communications strategy.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before continuing. Each name given its own quiet weight. Speaking from a place of reflection on past choices and their consequences. Steady but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、佐伯氏と経理体制を整えられた
lines.en: You and Saeki built the accounting structure from the ground up, if I remember right.
lines.style: Softer attack. Wistful, almost yearning quality — the voice of someone missing an era. Slight uncertainty in the phrasing, deferring to his authority. Warm invitation to confirm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは中谷氏を主任として育てられた
lines.en: Yes. And he developed Nakaya into a department head — a real pillar.
lines.style: Calm, reflective. Speaking of past development with quiet pride, not boasting. Respectful pause on the name. The tone of someone reviewing a life's work carefully and fairly.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、中井氏と海外法人を立ち上げられた
lines.en: And when you were younger, you established the overseas corporation with Nakai, didn't you.
lines.style: Wistful, almost dreamy quality. Slower pace — savoring the memory. Slight breathiness, as if reaching back across decades. Gentle question at the end, inviting him into the remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは川島氏に法務全般を委ねられた
lines.en: Yes. He placed all legal matters in Kawashima's hands — a decision that proved sound.
lines.style: Measured, final-sounding tone. Quiet authority without harshness. Slight weight on the affirmation — the voice of someone closing a chapter with respect. Calm, almost meditative.
